semantics.definition: The drawing code every element of the 3D world shares: the programs that run on the graphics card, with the one rule for the edge of the world; the helpers that hand shapes to it; and the sums for the eye.
semantics.responsibility: Hold what several Eidos components share, once. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Draw every element of the 3D world the same way.
